parsed.note_claim: Under UNCLOS Article 110(1)(d), warships may board vessels reasonably suspected of being without nationality on the high seas.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: a warship which encounters on the high seas a foreign ship ... is not justified in boarding it unless there is reasonable ground for suspecting that: ... (d) the ship is without nationality;
parsed.reason: The cited UNCLOS text directly states the right of visit for a warship where there are reasonable grounds to suspect a ship is stateless.
